line_items.reasoning: Management guided for double-digit net sales growth in 2026, and Q1 delivered 12.4% daily sales growth YoY — the third consecutive quarter of double-digit growth — clearly meeting and slightly exceeding the directional target.

While operating margin improved 20 bps YoY (a positive), gross margin came in ~40 bps below FAST's own internal Q1 target and 50 bps below prior year, driven by tariff-related cost increases outpacing pricing actions — a clear miss on the gross margin line relative to their own expectations.

No specific Q1 CapEx figure was reported in the current results to compare against the ~3.5% of net sales 2026 guide, and guidance was reaffirmed, suggesting CapEx spending is tracking in line with plan.
